profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud.

The site says the platform orchestrates model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability. It quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale lets teams push the boundaries of generative AI by scaling workloads seamlessly, which removes infrastructure risk and lets the team focus on innovation rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. A second quote, attributed to an applied AI engineer at an unnamed customer, describes a model going from a suggestion to running in production the next day, where before Anyscale that would have taken a week or more.

No lawsuits and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
